credits.title: Twelve Moons
credits.overview: Sofia is 40, childless, with a neglectful marriage, and spiraling into chaos as her life unravels. With striking imagery and a raw central performance, the film is a haunting character study trapped in a social nightmare.

credits.title: Náufragos
credits.overview: Miriam, a 13-year-old teenager, will do whatever it takes to attend a party, even if that means risking her little brother's life.

credits.title: Una canción sobre lo que sea
credits.overview: Elena wants to record her song in a good studio. Desperate, she reconnects with an old privileged friend to ask for the money.

credits.title: No One Will Ever Know
credits.overview: An anodyne environment and a perennial lack of affection, push Lucia and Braulio to turn in the fiction world; to materialize their dreams. Neither inclement reality can stop them.

credits.title: April's Daughters
credits.overview: Valeria is 17 and pregnant. She lives in Puerto Vallarta with Clara, her half sister. Valeria has not wanted her long-absent mother, April, to find out about her pregnancy, but due to the economic strain and the overwhelming responsibility of having a baby in the house, Clara decides to call their mother.
